# ETCCDITempIndices { #wass2s.ETCCDITempIndices }

```python
ETCCDITempIndices()
```

Factory for creating standard ETCCDI temperature indices.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [cold_days](#wass2s.ETCCDITempIndices.cold_days) | Create calculator for cold days (TX10p). |
| [cold_nights](#wass2s.ETCCDITempIndices.cold_nights) | Create calculator for cold nights (TN10p). |
| [hot_days](#wass2s.ETCCDITempIndices.hot_days) | Create calculator for hot days (TX90p). |
| [hot_nights](#wass2s.ETCCDITempIndices.hot_nights) | Create calculator for hot nights (TN90p). |
